snippet.title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Yellow Lemon Trailer
snippet.description:
This game on Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4148490/Sweetie_Candy_Maze_Yellow_Lemon/

Sweetie Candy Maze: Yellow Lemon — is a colorful and fun maze game set in a world of juicy yellow lemon candies and sweet surprises. Collect all the sweets and find your way to the caramel portal to complete each level.

Each new maze brings more challenge and excitement as you explore deeper into the candy world!

In Sweetie Candy Maze: Yellow Lemon:

• 50 levels of candy-filled fun
• Bright and tasty visuals
• Gradually increasing difficulty
• Addictive and cheerful gameplay
• Relaxing music
• Achievements
• Simple controls

Use Gamepads (Xbox One or Xbox 360), or keyboard (WASD or arrow keys) to navigate through the different mazes!
